sources.notes: The 421-page scan includes plates. Pottery labels, reported cultural coexistence and proposed teaching are distinct. BPR-208 is called quartz on p.118 and banded agate on p.122, both unfinished from mid-IB; it is not counted as two independent objects. Bulk composition of twelve sherds lacks a geological source-control frame and precise phase assignment in the inspected analysis. TL errors, differing depth trends and a measurement-year BP baseline preclude converting its table into a precise teaching chronology.
